meta.title: 6 habits of people who never seem stressed

beats.text: Six habits of people who somehow never seem stressed.
One. They plan tomorrow the night before. They wake up aimed, not scrambling.
Two. They do the worst task first. Dread shrinks the moment the hard thing is done.
Three. They single-task. Juggling everything at once is how the mind frays.
Four. They leave margin. They don't schedule every minute, so surprises don't topple the day.
Five. They control their inputs — fewer alerts, less doom-scrolling, quieter mornings.
Six. They let go of what they can't control, fast. They don't rent out their mind to it.
Calm people aren't dodging stress. They've just built a life that generates less of it.
